title: Warranty and care plans
meta_description: Every Tuga device has a 12-month warranty. Add the 3-Year Warranty with carriage paid both ways, or Total Care for fleets with a swap unit dispatched the same working day.
h1: Warranty and care plans for Tuga devices
lede: Every Tuga device comes with 12 months against defects. If you want longer, or you run a fleet that cannot wait for a repair, there are two paid plans, with published prices and numbered terms you can send to your finance team.
intro: Every Tuga device comes with a 12-month warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. If you want longer, or you run a fleet that cannot wait for a repair, there are two paid plans. All three are given by us, Destello Tech Ltd trading as Tuga Hardware, company number 16595781, registered in England, registered office 124 Vicarage Wood, Harlow, Essex CM20 3HH. Every line in the 3-Year Warranty and Total Care columns below has a matching numbered clause in the Plan Terms (clauses 5 to 43); the included warranty is set out in clauses 44 to 49 of the same Terms and in our Terms of Business, which say the same thing. You can send either document to your finance team.

The 3-Year Warranty extends the defects warranty to 36 months from dispatch, covers the battery against defects for the whole term like any other part, and we pay UK carriage both ways on every accepted claim. It is available on every Tuga model. One price per device, the same at any quantity: A6 £65, A8 £65, A10 £65, W8 £79, W10 £79, WH6 £89.

Total Care is for business fleets of five or more devices, on any Tuga model, and sole traders count as a business. If a device fails and we accept the claim by 14:00 on a working day, we dispatch a swap unit with your software image on it the same day, for delivery the next working day to addresses on our courier's standard next-day network (we check your sites by postcode when you join; other addresses, including Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the Isle of Wight and the Isle of Man, get same-day dispatch and two to five working days in transit). We service the batteries at month 18, hold swap stock for your fleet, lend you a unit for trials, answer the phone, report quarterly, and at the end of life we collect, erase and certify. If we miss the delivery level on a standard-network address we add time to your term, and the Terms say exactly how much. Per device for fleets of 10 or more: A6 £249, A8 £269, A10 £279, W8 £299, W10 £299, WH6 £329. Fleets of 5 to 9 devices pay £30 more per device: A6 £279, A8 £299, A10 £309, W8 £329, W10 £329, WH6 £359.

Neither plan covers accidental damage. We do not insure devices, and no insurer or other third party stands behind the plans: the remedy is always our own repair, replacement or service, never a cash payment. We say so because you should know who you are relying on. Prices are per device and are the amounts payable today; we are not currently VAT registered.

care: Everything in the 3-Year Warranty, including carriage paid both ways

Advance replacement: for a claim accepted by 14:00 on a working day we dispatch a swap unit of the same model, carrying your current approved image, the same working day on a next-working-day courier service with tracking and declared value

Delivery service level: the swap unit is delivered by the end of the next working day after acceptance to addresses on our courier's published standard next-working-day network, confirmed by postcode at onboarding and listed in your fleet schedule. Other addresses, including Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the Isle of Wight and the Isle of Man, get same-day dispatch on the courier's fastest available service with a target of two to five working days

Service credit if we miss the delivery level on a standard-network address: one month added to the Total Care term of the affected device for each working day of delay, up to three months per incident, applied without you asking

Swap pool held by us: at least one pre-imaged swap unit for every 20 covered devices of each model, minimum one for each model covered and at least one for every fleet, so a fleet of five has a swap unit from day one, charged and function-tested quarterly, never scheduled out beyond what it holds. At onboarding we quote one customer-held spare of each model per site at your fleet discount, replenished by us within three working days of use

Scheduled battery service at month 18 (within a 60-day window centred on month 18): W10, a new battery pack for every covered W10 sent to your site by road courier in one consignment under our carrier's dangerous-goods acceptance; A6, A8, A10, W8 and WH6, a capacity reading on every covered device (Windows battery report on the W8 and WH6, our diagnostic app on the Android models) and a workshop battery replacement, seal tested, for every device below 80% of rated, run in batches sized to the swap pool across the window
Pre-imaging: one approved image per model built from your configuration at onboarding and applied to every new device and every swap unit, with up to two image revisions per model per contract year

Fleet support desk: phone and email 08:30 to 17:30 on working days, acknowledgement within two working hours, triage started within four working hours, with a pooled allowance of one hour per covered device over the term, shared across your fleet
One loan device per account per contract year for up to 30 days to evaluate a new model, software or workflow, dispatched within five working days of request, carriage paid by us

care_note: Neither plan covers accidental damage, liquid damage, theft or loss. We do not insure devices and no insurer or other third party stands behind the plans: the remedy is always our own repair, replacement or service, never a cash payment.
consumer_info: Information for consumers, which we are required to give and would give anyway. Extended warranties for electronic devices are available from other providers, and you may wish to compare them. If you are buying for your home, your household insurance may already be relevant to some of the same risks. You do not have to buy a plan at the same time as the device: either plan can be added within 30 days of dispatch at the published price, and the 3-Year Warranty up to the end of month 12 after a remote check. There is no financial protection scheme behind the plans: if Destello Tech Ltd stopped trading, the plans would end. Making a claim does not end a plan; it continues for the rest of its term. Consumers can cancel a plan within 45 days for a full refund if no claim has been made, and your statutory rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 and the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 are not affected; see clauses 3, 34, 46 and 47 of the Terms.

claim_steps: 1. Check the register. Every device dispatched with a paid plan is recorded by serial number on our warranty register at dispatch, with the plan, dispatch date and end date. Ask us at any time for the serial, plan and end date we hold for your device. The Terms are at tugahardware.com/warranty-terms. A claim is accepted only for a serial on the register.

2. Tell us. Email support@tugahardware.com or call us on a working day (08:30 to 17:30) with the serial number (on the back of the device and on your invoice), what the device is doing, what you have tried, and where possible a photo, a short video or a diagnostic report (Windows battery report on the W8, W10 and WH6; our diagnostic app or the battery statistics screen on the A6, A8 and A10). We log the time and give you a claim reference. Under Total Care the nominated site contact logs the claim and gives the delivery address for the swap unit, which must be one listed in your fleet schedule or confirmed by us in writing.

3. We reply. 3-Year Warranty: within one working day. Total Care: acknowledgement within two working hours and triage started within four working hours. We work through a published checklist of no more than 20 minutes of your time: power and charger check, forced restart, known-good charger, battery reading, visible damage check. If the fault clears, we close the claim with a note on the register. If the photos show excluded damage (cracked glass, liquid indicators, crushing) we say so now and offer a fixed-price repair quote instead of a warranty claim. This step removes most no-fault-found returns and keeps carriage free for everyone.

4. Acceptance. We confirm acceptance by email with the claim number. 3-Year Warranty: this triggers the prepaid Royal Mail Tracked 24 label (bought pay-as-you-go through Click and Drop and emailed to you) the same working day and, if you ask, a box. Total Care: this starts the dispatch clock. If accepted by 14:00 on a working day, the pre-imaged swap unit is booked on the next-working-day courier account with declared value and leaves the same day, with the prepaid return label in the box. A claim accepted after 14:00 counts as accepted at 08:30 the next working day. Log by 12:00 with the checklist completed and you have our decision by 14:00.

5. The device travels. 3-Year Warranty: back up your data, remove the SIM and memory card, pack the device in your packaging or our box, attach the label and drop it off or book collection. We pay the carriage. Total Care: the swap unit arrives the next working day at addresses on the courier's standard next-day network (listed in your fleet schedule). For other addresses, including Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the Isle of Wight and the Isle of Man, it leaves the same day on the fastest available service and typically arrives in two to five working days. Put the faulty device in the swap box, apply the prepaid label and send it back within ten working days.

6. Inspection. Within two working days of receiving a device we inspect it, record the finding on the RMA log (defect confirmed, no fault found, excluded damage) and tell you the outcome, the action and the expected dispatch date. Workshop rule: repair when parts plus labour are under half the cost of a replacement device, which covers screens, battery packs, ports, buttons and speakers; replace for mainboard faults and liquid ingress.

7. Repair or replace. 3-Year Warranty: we repair or replace and dispatch by tracked next-day carrier, target five working days from receipt. If we cannot dispatch the repaired device within ten working days of receipt we send a replacement device instead. We tell you which we did and why. Total Care: the swap unit already with you becomes the covered device; the returned device is repaired, re-imaged and goes back into the swap pool, or is scrapped and replaced in the pool from new stock. For a battery job on any model except the W10 we replace the pack, refit the seals and run a leak test before the unit is used again.

8. Battery faults. A battery that fails through a defect (it will not hold or take a charge, it swells, or it loses capacity far faster than normal ageing explains) is handled like any other claim, under either paid plan. Send us the device's battery reading and we confirm it in our workshop with three readings across three full charge cycles. W10: we send a new pack with fitting instructions by road courier under our carrier's dangerous-goods acceptance; you fit it in under a minute and take the old pack to a local battery recycling point, or keep it for collection with the device at end of life. We never ask you to post a battery back. A6, A8, A10, W8 and WH6: the battery is not user-removable, so we replace the pack in our workshop under the normal label-and-return process and test the seal before return.

9. Total Care month-18 battery service. We contact your site contact from month 17 and agree a schedule for the 60-day window centred on month 18. W10: a new pack for every covered W10, sent to your site in one consignment by road courier with fitting instructions; old packs go to local battery recycling or are held for end-of-life collection. A6, A8, A10, W8 and WH6: we take a capacity reading of every covered device (the Windows battery report on the W8 and WH6, our diagnostic app on the A6, A8 and A10, or through your MDM where you allow it). Every device below 80% is re-batteried in our workshop in batches: we send swap units from the pool for the first batch, you return those devices on the prepaid labels, and the next batch is scheduled once the previous one is re-batteried, resealed and re-imaged. No batch is larger than the swap units available, so a large cohort is worked through the window, or longer by agreement.

10. No fault found or excluded damage. 3-Year Warranty: we tell you before charging, then charge £35 for inspection and return carriage and return the device, or you can ask us for a repair quote. Total Care: the first two no-fault returns per contract year are free, then £35 each. For excluded damage under Total Care we send a fixed-price repair quote within two working days; you either accept it (the swap unit stays with you and the repaired device joins the pool), return the swap unit within ten working days, or buy the swap unit at list less your fleet discount.

11. Close and record. The register is updated so the repaired device, or the replacement serial, carries the rest of the original term (or 90 days if longer), and the replaced device or part is marked as our property. The term does not restart. The RMA log records the costs (parts, labour hours, carriage including declared value) and the clock times (logged, accepted, dispatched, delivered, returned) so service credits can be calculated and a repair rate can be published once we have at least 12 months and several hundred devices of history, with the method stated.

12. Service credit (Total Care only). If the swap unit was delivered to a standard-network address after the delivery level, we add one month of Total Care to that device for each working day of delay, up to three months per incident, confirm it in the claim closure email and show it in the next quarterly fleet report. You do not have to ask. The only exceptions are delays caused at your end (wrong or unattended address, refused delivery), events outside the reasonable control of both of us, and working days of planned absence we notified in advance. Addresses outside the standard network do not carry the credit.

faq.a: The 3-Year Warranty is a warranty given by the seller, Destello Tech Ltd trading as Tuga Hardware, against defects in materials and workmanship, including the battery. Total Care is a service contract that includes that warranty. The remedy is our own repair, replacement or service, never a cash payment. No insurer or other third party stands behind either plan, which is also why neither covers accidental damage. Both are in addition to your legal rights and do not reduce them.

A fault in materials or workmanship that stops the device, or a part of it, working as described in its specification. A drop, a cracked screen, liquid inside a sealed port, or a battery that has lost capacity through normal ageing are not defects. The full exclusions are in clause 17 of the Terms, and they are the same list on this page.

faq.q: How do you test a battery?
faq.a: We compare the battery controller's reported full charge capacity with the rated capacity, read three times across three full charge cycles. On the W8, W10 and WH6 we use the Windows battery report (full charge capacity against design capacity); on the A6, A8 and A10 our diagnostic app reads the charge counter. Under the 3-Year Warranty we use the reading to confirm a battery defect; gradual capacity loss with age and use is normal and is not covered. Under Total Care every A6, A8, A10, W8 and WH6 is read at month 18 and re-batteried in our workshop if below 80%, and every W10 gets a new pack at month 18 regardless of reading. The method is written into the Terms so the result is not a matter of opinion.

On an accepted claim under either paid plan, we do, both ways, anywhere in the UK, using the label we send. Under the included 12-month warranty, business buyers pay to send the device to us and we pay the return; if you buy as a consumer and the device is faulty, we pay both ways. If we find no defect or an excluded fault we may charge £35 for inspection and return carriage, and we tell you before we charge. W10 battery packs are sent by road courier; we never ask you to post a battery back.

faq.q: What does next working day actually mean?
faq.a: A working day is Monday to Friday excluding bank holidays in England and Wales. Under Total Care, if we accept your claim by 14:00 on a working day we dispatch a pre-imaged swap unit that day on a next-working-day courier, so it is delivered by the end of the following working day to addresses on the courier's standard next-day network. We check every delivery address by postcode when you join and list the ones on that network in your fleet schedule. Addresses outside it, including Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the Isle of Wight and the Isle of Man, get the same-day dispatch on the fastest service available, which typically takes two to five working days, and the service credit does not apply there. Acceptance means we have confirmed the serial is on our register and a remote check of no more than 20 minutes has not cleared the fault. Log the claim by 12:00 with the checklist done and you have our decision by 14:00. A claim accepted after 14:00 counts as accepted at 08:30 the next working day.

faq.q: What happens if the swap unit arrives late?
faq.a: If the address is on the standard next-day network, we add one month to the Total Care term of that device for each working day of delay, up to three months per incident, and we apply it without you asking. The exceptions are delays caused at your end (wrong or unattended address, refused delivery), events outside the reasonable control of both of us, such as severe weather or a strike, and working days of planned closure we told you about at least five working days in advance, when we position swap stock or your customer-held spare beforehand. This term extension is the only remedy for a missed service level, and the Terms say so.

faq.q: Why is the 3-Year Warranty turnaround a target and not a guarantee?
faq.a: Because we are a small workshop and we only promise what the price funds. The 3-Year Warranty price pays for repair, replacement and carriage, not for a swap pool. So we publish a five-working-day target, tell you within two working days of receipt what we will do and when, and if we cannot dispatch the repaired device within ten working days we send a replacement instead. Total Care funds the swap pool, and that is where the guaranteed level with a written remedy lives.

faq.q: Can I buy a plan later?
faq.a: Within 30 days of dispatch, yes, at the published price and without inspection. From day 31 to the end of month 12 you can add the 3-Year Warranty after a short remote diagnostic check of each device (battery reading and photos), which we may decline. Total Care can be added in that window only for devices joining an existing Total Care fleet. In every case the term runs from the original dispatch date. After month 12 the plans are not available. You do not have to buy a plan with the device, and extended warranties are also available from other providers.

faq.q: What happens if the device is replaced, returned or cancelled?
faq.a: A replacement takes over the plan for the rest of the original term, or 90 days if that is longer; the term does not restart. If you return the device under our 30-day returns policy for business buyers, or cancel a distance purchase within 14 days as a consumer, we refund the plan in full with it. You can cancel either plan within 30 days of purchase for a full refund if you have made no claim (45 days if you buy as a consumer, and we tell you so in your confirmation email). After that the 3-Year Warranty refunds pro rata by full unexpired months; Total Care runs for its fixed 36-month term. Making a claim does not end a plan.

faq.q: Why do fleets of 5 to 9 pay more for Total Care?
faq.a: Some of the work in Total Care costs the same for five devices as for fifty: building and testing your image, onboarding your sites and holding at least one swap unit for your fleet. Fleets of 5 to 9 devices pay £30 more per device to cover it (A6 £279, A8 £299, A10 £309, W8 £329, W10 £329, WH6 £359); once your account holds 10 or more Total Care devices, counting the ones you are adding, every device on that quote takes the lower price (A6 £249, A8 £269, A10 £279, W8 £299, W10 £299, WH6 £329). Total Care is available on every Tuga model, and you can mix models in one fleet.

Not at the moment. The 3-Year Warranty and Total Care are one-off prices, and Total Care is paid in advance on a proforma invoice. If you need to spread the cost of a fleet, tell us and we will let you know if a monthly option becomes available.
